Subject: Cross-team concordance & risk pulse: pre-QBR check and final asks

Team — quick sync ahead of tomorrow's QBR rehearsal. Objective: confirm the remaining open risks that could materially affect the Acme go-live window and surface any cross-functional blockers we need exec visibility on. I attached the latest QBR playbook and the pricing matrix for reference.

Topline (2-minute): Acme remains on track for a phased launch beginning 2027-01-10, scalable to 100k monthly active users by end of Q1 pending final pricing sign and support-runbook approvals. Outstanding items below.

Open items (owners and target):
- Support readiness: on-call rota and escalation SLOs (Owner: Ben C.) — target 11/11 EOD
- Pricing redline: one remaining discount clause for committed volume (Owner: Karthik) — target 11/10 noon
- Enablement content: runbook + 2 training sessions for Acme CS (Owner: Laura) — target 11/12
- Marketplace listing: legal review for CloudPartner integration (Owner: Vivek) — target 11/10 COB

Asks: please reply inline with the current status, gaps, and any blockers you want me to raise in the exec rehearsal. If you prefer a 15-minute pre-call today, state availability.

Notes: Julia & Sunil — thanks for joining in advance. We'll keep external recipients on status threads but we will mark any sensitive items separately.

Best,
Marissa
Director, Go-to-Market Operations

Pricing update:
- Negotiation status: Acme has requested a 25% floor on committed-month discounts tied to performance SLAs. We have a counter that uses a stepped discount tied to MAU tiers with a maximum of 20% and a performance kicker. Sent redline to Acme legal at 10:30; awaiting feedback.
- Internal ask: If Acme insists on 25% floor, we need exec approval for a concession and a compensating revenue guardrail (6-month minimum commitment). I can draft the concession language for review.

Operational impact: the pricing shape affects our initial capacity commit and the Dedicated capacity sizing. If pricing is agreed at the higher discount, we need to revisit the Dedicated capacity reservation and pre-warming plan by 11/12.

Karthik
Head of Product Partnerships
Redwood Inference
